fact: Senegal's October 2020 ITU forum contribution states the national high and very high speed plan costs 1,094 billion FCFA over ten years, financed 73% private, 17% public and 10% PPP, and reports over 13,000 km of fibre deployed.
title: Développement des infrastructures à large bande au Sénégal
publisher: Ministère de l'Économie numérique et des Télécommunications (MENT), Sénégal
